news.title: 2025 Outlook: Europe’s Economies Brace for More Political Upheaval
news.description: Recession looks avoidable for Europe in 2025, but significant growth is still elusive. This episode of RBC Capital Market’s Strategic Alternatives considers the prospects, weighing political volatility in the region, central banks’ rate-cutting cycles, and potential U.S. interventions. What does all this mean for investors? Janet Wilkinson, Managing Director, Head of Global Markets Flow Sales, EMEA, is joined by Peter Schaffrik, Chief European Macro Strategist, and Cathal Kennedy, Senior U.K. Economist.
news.author: Janet Wilkinson, Peter Schaffrik & Cathal Kennedy
